items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: So, did you see the picture? With George Washington.

ctx.x: When would he finally start doing that? Was that towards the end of his life?

You know, that wasn't towards the end of his life. He did it so often. He told it to you. He was just put on the shelf. Because I came over here. I was there in Manorville. Let me talk. And I came over here after the band is all where Edmund Hall left the band. And I got it in Black in town. So, did you see the picture? With George Washington. I don't know. What it matter? Just on Facebook. I don't know. I'm going to finish that. And it was. We call it Facel. That's why Zoothing all of them got it in the way they…
How long were you doing that? Some of you haven't had everybody to do it for your counseling?
